title: 验证自动缺陷复核是否真的能减少 Bug
summary: 保留为一个实验性用户需求，而不是生产阻断机制。旧依赖已失效，实验语料、指标、预算和停止条件需要在新的需求管理与执行架构完成后重新设计；在此之前不实现 Shadow、不启用任何自动阻断。
goals: Define bounded risk signals and verification packs for persistence, migration, retry/idempotency, uncertainty, contradictory evidence, and residual risk.
Add low-cost Risk Probe and selectively invoked Challenge review without making either an autonomous blocker.
Run Baseline, Equal-budget Review, and Mechanism experiments with predeclared metrics and stop conditions.
Promote only mechanisms that improve actionable early findings without unacceptable latency, false positives, or Harness self-failure.
nonGoals: Do not claim bugs can be eliminated or require exhaustive testing.
Do not run a heavy multi-agent review on every task.
Do not let Challenge output alone reject or finalize work.
Do not enable production blocking gates before Shadow evidence meets declared thresholds.
Do not begin this Issue while foundational reliability Issues remain incomplete.
acceptanceCriteria: Risk signals and verification packs are bounded, deterministic where possible, and connected to actual task/evidence/context state.
The mechanism records Finding type, evidence, affected acceptance criterion, actionability, disposition, and whether it was found earlier than baseline.
Experiments compare Baseline, Equal-budget Review, and Mechanism under matched task/budget conditions.
Reported metrics include precision, actionable rate, early-detection rate, escaped-defect rate where measurable, latency/cost overhead, and Harness self-failure rate.
False positives, duplicated findings, contradictory probes, and infrastructure failures are separated from product defects.
No blocking gate is enabled unless predeclared precision, actionability, overhead, and stability thresholds pass across representative task classes.
A failed experiment leaves the existing execution path unchanged and produces a reusable evidence report.
relatedArtifacts: new requirement-management and SQLite architecture dependency

tasks.title: Freeze experiment questions, corpus, metrics, and stop conditions
tasks.objective: After the three foundational result Issues are stable, select representative historical and new tasks; define matched budgets, baseline conditions, finding taxonomy, metrics, promotion thresholds, rollback, and stop conditions before implementing the mechanism.
acceptanceCriteria: Completion of ISS-20260730-A1EA53, the relevant context foundation in ISS-20260730-84CE88, and callability E2E in ISS-20260730-B55445 is verified.
The evaluation corpus spans persistence, migration, retry/idempotency, context conflict, ordinary repository edits, and specialist workflows.
Metrics and thresholds are fixed before results are collected.
Known limitations and confounders are documented.
notes: Controller-enforced external gate. Unblock to ready only after RC6 is terminal and the execution-evidence foundation, relevant Apple context foundation, and Core/Advanced/Full category-callability E2E are verified. The experiment must remain non-blocking Shadow until promotion gates pass.

RC6 gate is now satisfied at released revision 2a48486b7b8c3395d05e4f30201e968ee88f9779, but this Shadow Task intentionally remains blocked. Do not launch until the execution-evidence foundation in ISS-20260730-A1EA53, the relevant Apple context foundation in ISS-20260730-84CE88, and Core/Advanced/Full category-callability E2E in ISS-20260730-B55445 are verified. Shadow must remain non-blocking until predeclared promotion gates pass.

tasks.title: Implement verification packs and finding persistence
tasks.objective: Add bounded verification packs for persistence, migration, retry/idempotency, uncertainty, contradictory evidence, and residual risk; persist structured findings with evidence links, disposition, and deduplication/idempotency.
acceptanceCriteria: Each pack has explicit trigger inputs, bounded work, output schema, and failure classification.
Retries do not duplicate findings or overwrite stronger evidence.
Pack infrastructure failures are not reported as product bugs.
Sensitive data remains redacted.

tasks.title: Add bounded Risk Probe and selective Challenge review
tasks.objective: Introduce a cheap Risk Probe that selects relevant verification packs and a separately budgeted Challenge review invoked only for high-uncertainty/high-impact cases; neither may be the sole completion authority.
acceptanceCriteria: Default low-risk tasks avoid heavy review.
Probe decisions are explainable and bounded by task/evidence/context inputs.
Challenge is rate-limited, budgeted, and produces evidence-backed findings.
Final decisions remain with existing Work/evidence/authorization gates.

tasks.title: Instrument Shadow execution and matched-budget controls
tasks.objective: Run the mechanism without changing task outcomes; add Baseline, Equal-budget Review, and Mechanism assignment, timing/cost capture, finding lifecycle, fallback, and Harness self-failure telemetry.
acceptanceCriteria: Shadow cannot block, mutate, or silently reroute production work.
Experimental groups receive comparable budgets and task classes.
Instrumentation distinguishes model, tool, infrastructure, and repository failures.
Disabling Shadow restores the exact prior path without data migration.

tasks.title: Run the experiment and classify every finding
tasks.objective: Execute the predeclared corpus and representative live Shadow tasks; independently classify findings as true/false, actionable/non-actionable, earlier/not-earlier, duplicate/novel, and product/Harness/infrastructure.
acceptanceCriteria: Every reported metric is traceable to bounded evidence.
No cherry-picked task or post-hoc threshold changes are used without a separate exploratory label.
Failures and negative results are retained.
The raw evidence set is bounded and redacted.

tasks.title: Decide promotion, revision, or rejection of the mechanism
tasks.objective: Compare results with predeclared gates; either promote a narrowly scoped gate, continue Shadow with revised hypotheses, or reject/remove the mechanism. Record exact scope, rollback, and remaining uncertainty.
acceptanceCriteria: Promotion requires precision, actionable rate, early-detection benefit, overhead, and self-failure gates to pass.
Any production gate is limited to task classes proven by the experiment and has an immediate disable path.
A non-promotion result leaves ordinary execution unaffected.
All temporary worktrees/branches are merged or discarded and cleaned.
